outcome: Bleeding volume at 2 and 24 hours after delivery
Generic Quality of Life Inventory-74 (GQOL-74) score
cohort: 183 patients with postpartum hemorrhage treated at the First Affiliated Hospital of Chengdu Medical College
finding: Bedside nursing intervention for patients with postpartum hemorrhage improved coagulation factor levels, reduced postpartum bleeding volumes and complications, and led to improvements in sleep quality, nursing satisfaction, and quality of life.
